metadata.title: Cathie Wood’s ARK Just Dumped AMD Stock. What She’s Buying Instead. <!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Cathie Wood’s ARK Just Dumped AMD Stock. What She’s Buying Instead.
Advanced Micro Devices looks to be falling out of favor with prominent technology investor Cathie Wood. And its chip peers Broadcom and Cerebras Systems are the favored replacement.
